title: Hubspot email html images clickthrough loss

change.control: Near-plain-text marketing email with minimal HTML for tracking and links.
change.variant: Use an HTML email template containing images.

significance.reported: Publisher says the plainer variation won with statistical significance.

quote: For the plain-text vs. HTML template with images test, the HTML email version had a 21% lower clickthrough rate
notes: Combined with lower opens, the HTML version had 51% fewer total clicks. Over half a billion emails refers to a separate observational customer-email analysis, not this A/B sample.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
